diagnostics.message: `local_file.public_ssh_key` declares `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content` already references `tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh`, so the explicit `depends_on` duplicates an ordering Terraform already infers. The depends_on can be removed.

`local_file.private_ssh_key` declares `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content` already references `tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem`, so the explicit `depends_on` duplicates an ordering Terraform already infers. The depends_on can be removed.

`aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance` launches the runner agent, whose user-data registers the runner and writes the registration token into SSM. That requires the instance role to already have the SSM policy attached (`aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm`). The ASG only depends transitively on the role (via launch config -> instance profile -> aws_iam_role.instance), not on the role's policy attachments, so an instance can boot before the SSM policy is attached and fail to store the token. Add an explicit `depends_on` on the IAM role policy attachment(s).
